verse.verse_1: By the sun and its rising brightness
verse.verse_2: and by the moon as it follows it,
verse.verse_3: and by the day as it reveals its glory
verse.verse_4: and by the night when it draws a veil over it,
verse.verse_5: by the sky and how He built it
verse.verse_6: and by the earth and how He spread it,
verse.verse_7: by the soul and how He formed it,
verse.verse_8: then inspired it to understand what was right and wrong for it.
verse.verse_9: He who purifies it will indeed be successful,
verse.verse_10: and he who corrupts it is sure to fail.
verse.verse_11: The Thamud tribe rejected the truth because of their arrogance,
verse.verse_12: when the most wicked man among them rose up.
verse.verse_13: Then the messenger of God said to them, "This is God's she-camel. Let her drink."
verse.verse_14: But they gave him the lie, and hamstrung the she-camel. So their Lord destroyed them for their crime and razed their city to the ground.
verse.verse_15: He did not fear the consequences.
